title: Don’t Have an Official N.Y.C. Trash Bin? Now It’ll Cost You.
summary: Residential buildings with fewer than 10 units are required to put out their trash in official “NYC Bins” as part of the city’s efforts to deter rats. Owners who don’t comply will be fined.
